title: John Lennon writes I’m Stepping Out | 1980
content:
John Lennon wrote the song ‘I’m Stepping Out’ on 21 June 1980.

Although it was the first song to be recorded during the Double Fantasy sessions in August 1980, ‘I’m Stepping Out’ wasn’t released until 1984’s Milk And Honey.

Lennon composed the song in Bermuda. On 19 June 1980 he visited a Hamilton nightclub, Disco 40, with his assistant Fred Seaman. The next day, slightly hungover but enthused by the experience, he wrote ‘I’m Stepping Out’.

Although Lennon’s Bermuda trip formed the basis of ‘I’m Stepping Out’, he used elements of songs composed earlier. Key among them was ‘That’s The Way The World Is’, a song begun in 1979 which eventually became ‘Real Life’. In early demo recordings it contained the lyrics which Lennon eventually used during the middle section of ‘I’m Stepping Out’.
